test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A hemispherical bowl has a 3.5 cm radius. It is to be painted inside as well as outside. Find the cost of painting it at the rate of ₹17 per 10 cm².

(Use pi = (22)/(7) )
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total surface area to be painted (Inside + Outside) = 2 × 2πr² = 4πr².

Radius (r) = 3.5 cm = 7/2 cm.

Total Area = 4 × (22/7) × (7/2) × (7/2) = 154 cm².

Cost = (154 ÷ 10) × 17 = 15.4 × 17 = ₹261.8.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹261.8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius (r) = **3.5 cm**

Rate of painting = **₹17 per 10 cm²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddfc07e227d7d63f25784768a492f264f7f8e029742a129f8228aa4477b35528.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of hemisphere = 2πr²

Total painting area = Inside CSA + Outside CSA = 2πr² + 2πr² = **4πr²**

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Area = 4 × (22/7) × 3.5 × 3.5

⇒ Total Area = 4 × (22/7) × 12.25

⇒ Total Area = 154 cm²

⇒ Cost of painting 10 cm² = ₹17

⇒ Cost of painting 1 cm² = ₹1.7

⇒ Total Cost = 154 × 1.7

⇒ Total Cost = ₹261.8

**∴ The correct answer is ₹261.8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of Sphere

Total surface area of a full sphere is 4πr².

Total Surface Area of Hemisphere

For a solid hemisphere, TSA = CSA + Area of base = 2πr² + πr² = 3πr².

Volume of Hemisphere

The volume of a hemisphere is (2/3)πr³.
